Results.Name: Hundreds of date checks are grouped without deleting or changing a review item
Information can be filtered separately and all original details remain accessible
Shareable diagnostics exclude free text, identifiers, names, paths and secrets
Unrecognized status and settings values cannot inject sensitive text into diagnostics
PDF analysis diagnostics retain counts without copying extracted evidence
Diagnostic exports are atomic new JSON files and protect existing application files
Safe operation history excludes arbitrary old log content and injected fields
Support events rotate, expire and keep legacy raw files separate
Standalone diagnostics work against an installation with an active application lock
Pending verification includes provisional daily files and clears only on actual confirmation
A scrubbed ZIP includes all retained activity and strips injected fields from every entry
Earlier activity contributes only recognized dates, operations and numeric counts
Error descriptions become safe categories rather than raw strings
Concurrent program workers keep every structured event without overwriting each other
A failed PDF read stays cached until the destination changes
Detailed report diagnoses keep independent reasons and opaque bundle references without private data
Unknown diagnostic and event fields cannot inject text or spreadsheet formulas
Printable diagnostics cap readable sections honestly while machine files retain every report and event
Standalone HTML exports protect files and sanitize even direct printable-report input
Classic diagnostics inspect cached versions without opening or changing PDF content
Additional and Daily metadata, Drive models and the third filing rule remain safely diagnosable
Real connection-result handling avoids repeated prompts and remembers only accepted sign-ins

Scope: Synthetic review grouping, strict diagnostic privacy, per-report reason categories, printable HTML limits, complete machine exports, protected destinations, cached-only classic fallback, safe events and active application lock. Production diagnostic CMD runs on Windows.
